name: What are the main phases of a ground-up construction project?

mainEntity.name: What are the main phases of a ground-up construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typical phases include due diligence and feasibility, design and engineering, permitting, site preparation and foundation, structural framing, rough-ins, insulation and drywall, finishes, inspections, and final handover. rsvc+2
